description: Use only after the user has agreed to the size that estimate_download reported, to package those files for the user to download. The package is built in the background as ZIP parts of about 10 GB, each listing its files (MANIFEST.csv) and any that could not be included (MISSING.csv). `include`: `all` (default) or `pdf` (report PDFs only, often much smaller). Only the signed-in user receives it: one email to their own address when it is ready, with the download links; it is kept for 14 days, then removed. Nothing else is changed. One package per user at a time; very large ones (over 200 GB) wait for the platform's approval. Returns the package's id and state; follow it with download_status.
name: prepare_download
title: Package documents for download
